description: Athletics events (48): code, Indonesian label, World Athletics name, kind, result unit, wind measurement; hurdle heights and spacings, steeplechase heights, implement weights per category, combined-events composition; O2SN 2026 per level (events, implements, trials, Kids' Athletics courses, qualifying marks); POPDA Jawa Tengah 2026 per level (events, implements, entry limits, exhibition rule, errata).
status: ready for World Athletics rules, O2SN 2026 and POPDA Jawa Tengah 2026; PASI U14/U16 and POPNAS events not published on a reachable official site (brief R-10b)
source: World Athletics Book C C1.1/C2.1 Competition & Technical Rules (amendments effective up to 2026-03-20, PDF 2026-07-17); IAAF Scoring Tables for Combined Events (2016); Puspresnas O2SN 2026 guides SD/MI, SMP/MTs, SMA/MA/SMK/MAK (March 2026) and the O2SN scoring tables they link to (Trilomba SMP, Pancalomba SMA/SMK; fetched 2026-11-26); Dispora Jawa Tengah, Juknis POPDA Tingkat Provinsi Jawa Tengah 2026 (letter 400.3.9.2/371/2026 of 27 February 2026, scanned; fetched 2026-11-27); Kemenpora Laporan Kinerja 2025 Sesdep 3 quoting the POPNAS age rule of Peraturan Ketua Umum PP BAPOPSI 8/2022 (fetched 2026-11-27). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/atletik/, sources/atletik/o2sn/, sources/atletik/popda-jateng/ and sources/atletik/popnas/
licence: Copyright World Athletics (rules, tables); Kemendikdasmen (O2SN guides), Pemerintah Provinsi Jawa Tengah (POPDA juknis) and Kemenpora (report) are public government documents; facts with references used under decision F-027
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/atletik.py, which checks the scoring parameters against printed table rows (with --tables: every row of the two O2SN tables, 17,595 rows) and the tables for completeness, then writes the three sets. The POPDA juknis is scanned: its facts were read on the page images, with PDF pages in `ref`. Version 2026-11-27 is the date the POPDA juknis was fetched, the newest source.
